entities.name: Giuseppe Verucchi
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Giuseppe Verucchi was an Italian Roman Catholic prelate. He was archbishop of Ravenna-Cervia from 2000 to 2012. Verucchi died in Modena on 12 February 2025, at the age of 87.
